SELECT 'sales' t, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_return_line

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id, p.sku, f.channel_code, f.product_key
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27'
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
ret AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) qret, COUNT(*) n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(sold.net_amount) sold_net, SUM(ret.refund_net) refunds, 
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(COALESCE(ret.refund_net,0))/SUM(sold.net_amount),2) rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ret.qret>sold.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_returned, SUM(CASE WHEN ret.n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi
FROM sold JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = sold.sku AND cp.is_current
LEFT JOIN ret ON ret.sales_line_id = sold.sales_line_id
WHERE cp.category IN ('Garden') OR cp.subcategory ILIKE '%Outdoor Lighting%'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, p.sku
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, cp.subcategory,
       ROUND(SUM(sold.net_amount), 2) AS sold_net_eur,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)), 2) AS returned_net_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) / SUM(sold.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = sold.sku AND cp.is_current
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sales_line_id = sold.sales_line_id
WHERE cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting'
GROUP BY cp.subcategory
ORDER BY cp.subcategory
